# Assessment overview

Supplementary analysis for the Photo Album application:

- [Architecture diagram](architecture-diagram.md) — Application components, deployment topology, and technology inventory.
- [Dependency map](dependency-map.md) — Declared dependencies, version management, and compatibility considerations.
- [API and service contracts](api-service-contracts.md) — HTTP endpoints, request and response contracts, and service interactions.
- [Data architecture](data-architecture.md) — Persistence model, database access, data ownership, and sensitivity.
- [Configuration inventory](configuration-inventory.md) — Runtime settings, environment profiles, and external configuration, with credentials redacted.
- [Business workflows](business-workflows.md) — Photo upload, browsing, retrieval, and deletion workflows.

See the [assessment report](../report.md) and [security assessment](../security/security-assessment.md) for findings and assessment limitations.
